notes.title: Patch 1.1.2!
notes.notes:
The version 1.1.2 is here! It features mostly visual changes, with some additional bugfixes (most importantly, getting rid off the progression blocker in the Elevator scene). The next patch, unless something very urgent comes up, will be the main part of the Exhibition (1.2.0) update. I'll be adding a new area to explore (the titular exhibition) as well as some more QoL changes – key binding remapping, among others.

Cheers!
